mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation_tbl (user_id, reservation_start_time, reservation_end_time, reservation_day, reservation_total_fee, rpz_id ) VALUES (#{userId}, #{reservationStartTime}, #{reservationEndTime}, #{reservationDay}, #{reservationTotalFee}, #{rpzId} )
mapper.select: SELECT rpz.rpz_num, rpz.rpz_address, reservation.reservation_day, reservation.reservation_start_time, reservation.reservation_end_time FROM ohfifthlane.reservation_tbl reservation join ohfifthlane.rpz_tbl rpz on reservation.rpz_id = rpz.rpz_id where reservation.user_id = #{userId}
